```text
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action cinematic fashion video, 15 seconds, vertical 9:16, one uninterrupted static overhead shot. Begin exactly from <Picture 1>.

Preserve the same adult East Asian woman’s facial identity, long dark hair, body proportions, skin tone and elegant appearance. Preserve the cream sofa, pale tiled floor, soft daylight, window curtains, foreground wooden ceiling fan, and all original spatial relationships. The opening outfit is exactly the original red velvet spaghetti-strap dress shown in <Picture 1>.

CAMERA LOCK: the camera remains absolutely fixed throughout the entire 15-second video. Maintain the same overhead viewpoint, framing, focal length, perspective, exposure and orientation. No cut, zoom, pan, tilt, shake, orbit, roll, reframing or composition drift.

FAN MOTION: the large wooden ceiling fan remains physically in the foreground and rotates continuously clockwise as viewed from the camera. Preserve the original blade count, dark-brown wood texture, blade length, hub position and physical depth. The fan moves at a slow, steady speed with restrained natural motion blur.

FULL-BODY TRANSFORMATION RULE: only one identifiable master blade triggers wardrobe, pose and expression changes. A valid transformation begins only when the master blade appears above the woman’s hair, then sweeps across her complete visible body from hair to toes. The new styling is revealed directly behind the blade’s trailing edge. Areas not yet covered by the blade remain in the previous styling state. Never transform the whole body at once.

POSE CONTINUITY RULE: the woman’s body motion must remain continuous across all styling states. Each new pose must evolve from the immediately previous pose through a physically plausible, low-amplitude adjustment while the master blade hides the moving body parts. Do not snap, teleport, reset, jump-cut, or replace the whole pose. The head, shoulders, arms, hands, torso, hips, knees, ankles and feet must each follow a visible before-to-after path: the previous position remains until the blade covers that body part, then the body part emerges behind the blade already moving into the next position. Every new pose must look like a continuation of the last pose, not a separate photo pose.

INITIAL STATE — 00:00.000 to 00:02.000: preserve the exact appearance and posture shown in <Picture 1>. The woman wears the original red velvet spaghetti-strap dress. She reclines on the cream sofa with one arm raised above her head, the other hand near her hair, her legs relaxed and naturally crossed. She looks calmly toward the camera with a soft composed expression. The master blade already crossing the frame continues its residual clockwise movement, but because this passage did not begin above her head within the video, it must not trigger any transformation. Only subtle breathing, one blink and slight hair movement are visible.

FIRST VALID FULL-BODY SWEEP — 00:02.000 to 00:05.000: the master blade reappears above her head. The transformation begins from the exact opening pose: one arm raised above her head, the other near her hair, legs relaxed and crossed. No change occurs before the blade touches the top of her hair.

As the blade covers her hair and face, her face turns only slightly toward a more frontal angle; her calm gaze firms into a poised professional look without changing identity. As the blade covers the raised arm, that arm bends down gradually from above her head toward a neat hand-near-waist position. As the blade covers the other arm, the hand that was near her hair glides only a short distance to rest beside her shoulder. As the blade covers her shoulders, chest and torso, the red velvet dress becomes a black-and-white fitted business skirt suit: a crisp white blouse, slim black tailored blazer, narrow black pencil skirt, fine black belt and clean structured lapels. As the blade covers the torso and hips, her reclined body remains on the sofa but straightens subtly, as if composing herself. As the blade covers the legs and feet, the existing relaxed leg-cross becomes a cleaner crossed-at-the-ankles pose, and the bare feet become glossy black pointed heels. The final business-suit pose is a refined continuation of the original reclining pose, not a reset. At 00:05.000, after the blade has passed beyond both feet, the professional outfit, composed expression and refined pose are complete.

HOLD — 00:05.000 to 00:06.000: retain the black-and-white business suit. She holds a controlled confident gaze, breathes subtly and blinks once. No other fan blade causes any change.

SECOND VALID FULL-BODY SWEEP — 00:06.000 to 00:09.000: the master blade reappears above her head. The transformation begins from the completed professional pose: one hand near the waist, the other near the shoulder, ankles crossed, torso composed. No change occurs before the blade touches the top of her hair.

As the blade covers her face, the professional expression softens into focused athletic calm, with a small energized smile. As the blade covers the shoulder-side arm, that arm curves upward only slightly from the shoulder area toward a relaxed near-head position. As the blade covers the waist-side arm, that hand releases tension and slides softly along the sofa toward her hip. As the blade covers her shoulders, chest and torso, the business suit becomes a fitted yoga outfit: a spaghetti-strap cropped yoga top that reveals the navel, paired with high-waisted tight yoga leggings. The color palette is sleek charcoal black with soft graphite accents. As the blade covers the torso, her composed business posture loosens into a relaxed athletic recline, rotating only a few degrees. As the blade covers the hips, legs and feet, the crossed ankles gradually uncross: one knee bends gently while the other leg extends diagonally. The pointed heels disappear only when the blade passes over the feet, leaving her naturally barefoot. The yoga pose must clearly grow out of the business pose through continuous movement. At 00:09.000, the yoga outfit, athletic relaxed pose and calm smile are complete.

HOLD — 00:09.000 to 00:10.000: retain the complete yoga styling. The woman keeps a natural breathing rhythm, her hair shifts slightly in the airflow, and the fan continues rotating at the same constant speed.

THIRD VALID FULL-BODY SWEEP — 00:10.000 to 00:13.000: the master blade reappears above her head for the final transformation. The transformation begins from the completed yoga pose: one arm relaxed near the head, the other near the hip, one knee softly bent and the other leg extended diagonally. No change occurs before the blade touches the top of her hair.

As the blade covers her face, her athletic smile becomes a relaxed home-lounge smile, with softer eyes and a calm intimate expression. As the blade covers the near-head arm, that arm settles into a loose comfortable curve beside her head rather than lifting higher. As the blade covers the hip-side arm, that hand rotates slightly and relaxes along the sofa cushion. As the blade covers her shoulders, chest and torso, the cropped yoga top becomes an off-shoulder home lounge top: soft ivory knit fabric, relaxed neckline exposing both shoulders, loose sleeves, comfortable drape, and casual indoor styling. As the blade covers the torso and hips, the athletic recline becomes softer and more casual without changing her position on the sofa. As the blade covers the waist, hips, legs and feet, the yoga leggings become ultra-short casual lounge shorts in pale grey cotton, with a soft waistband and clean hem. The bent knee opens only slightly and both legs settle into a relaxed offset reclining pose. The final off-shoulder loungewear pose must be a softened continuation of the yoga pose, not a new pose inserted after the wardrobe change. At 00:13.000, after the blade has passed beyond both feet, the off-shoulder home lounge top, ultra-short casual shorts, relaxed smile and final reclining pose are fully complete.

FINAL HOLD — 00:13.000 to 00:15.000: preserve the final off-shoulder home loungewear styling without further transformation. The woman maintains the comfortable final reclining pose, blinks once and holds a subtle relaxed smile. A few strands of hair and the soft lounge fabric respond gently to the fan airflow. End with the same fixed overhead composition, without text, logo, fade or camera movement.

HARD CONSTRAINTS: exactly three transformations; one complete styling transformation per valid master-blade sweep; every valid sweep starts above the woman’s hair and finishes below both feet; the master blade must cover the complete head-to-toe silhouette; outfit, pose and expression change only behind the master blade; every new pose must be a continuous physical continuation of the previous pose. Avoid instant full-body replacement, upper-body-only transformation, crossfade, dissolve, magical glow, facial identity drift, exaggerated expression, pose snapping, body teleportation, full-pose reset, body distortion, duplicated limbs, malformed hands, fused fingers, disconnected anatomy, unnatural joints, exposed underwear, wardrobe malfunction, fan wobble, fan reversal, disappearing blades, changed blade count, background movement, sofa deformation or camera movement.

overall_soundscape: A steady low ceiling-fan motor hum continues throughout, accompanied by rhythmic wooden-blade whooshes and subtle fabric movement. Each valid full-body sweep begins with a stronger directional air whoosh above the woman’s head and continues until the blade passes beyond both feet. No dialogue and no voiceover.

non_diegetic_music: A polished instrumental fashion-electronic track at approximately 108 BPM, with clean bass pulses, restrained percussion, soft synth chords and light metallic accents. The three full-body transformation sweeps begin on beat accents near 2.0, 6.0 and 10.0 seconds and resolve near 5.0, 9.0 and 13.0 seconds. The music remains continuous and ends with a controlled sustained chord.
```
